scripts.check: node --check src/catalog.mjs && node --check src/github.mjs && node --check src/indexer.mjs && node --check src/render.mjs && node --check src/score.mjs && node --check scripts/archive.mjs && node --check scripts/outputs.mjs && node --check scripts/paths.mjs && node --check scripts/refresh.mjs && node --check scripts/render.mjs && node --check scripts/validate.mjs
